scope: Private opt-in product receiver,owned-capability transport and native control roundtrip;not product PNG/full-native/main/owner/release qualification
requirements: Preserve all earlier6 modes,11 original scope refusals,4 tree refusals,lazy imports,8 byte-I/O controls and original32MiB proof.
Product integration is an explicit test-only environment opt-in: DISKED_GUI_CAPTURE_TEST=owned-client-tree/1. No new public command,source opener,output path,privilege or mutation surface.

WM_COPYDATA is read-only marshalled request data. Copy exactly640 bytes before parsing. Reject unknown version,nonzero padding,invalid bounded identifiers/dimensions/sequence/case and scope disagreement. Never retain message pointers.

Borrow only caller-transferred query/output handles;never close request-supplied numeric handles. Parent owns remote capability retirement after acknowledgement or verified process/job quiescence. No GDI handle crosses processes.

One anonymous pagefile section per request,view length4096+width*height*4<=16781312. Producer returns pixels only after own UI-thread/job/image/desktop/nonce/client/tree/frame checks and stable after checks. Publish total bytes at offset120 last;coordinator binds exact request/producer/pixel length and computes SHA256.
Receiver state is finite:8 attempts,strict next sequence,one nonce,non-reentrancy. Invalid inputs return false with no pixels/publication and no model action.

Actual cross-process control sends two distinct requests to one owned live renderer. Both A/B full-RGB results must match the existing frozen recipe. Retain separate request/case identities even when another control paints identical pixels.

A deliberately hung receiver must time out the sender without a ready frame;the3-second owning job retires it before handles/views are released. No retry,fallback or assumed quiescence after the send timeout.

Compile actual product GUI translation unit and link receiver into bootstrap products with lazy UI imports preserved. Full product executable/build/import/PNG qualification remains a separate mandatory gate.
